# Q1 Planning Meeting - 2024-01-10

**Attendees**: Sarah, Mike, Alex, me

## Agenda

1. Review Q4 metrics
2. Set Q1 goals
3. Discuss team structure

## Q4 Review

- Shipped 12 features (planned: 15)
- User growth: +23%
- Churn rate: 4.2% (down from 5.1%)

Sarah: "We're shipping too slowly. Need to reduce scope or add resources."

## Q1 Goals

1. **Product**: Launch mobile app beta
2. **Growth**: Reach 10K active users
3. **Infrastructure**: Migrate to Kubernetes

Mike concerned about infrastructure migration affecting feature velocity. Decided to run them in parallel with clear ownership.

## Action Items

- [ ] Sarah: Draft mobile app PRD
- [x] Mike: Infrastructure migration plan

- [ ] Me: Set up analytics dashboard

## Notes

Good discussion about balancing new features vs. technical debt. Team agreed on 70/30 split (70% features, 30% infrastructure/refactoring).
